title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on John 13: the washing of the disciples' feet, the piece of bread given to Judas, and the new commandment.

questions.text: What did Jesus do after he arose from supper and laid aside his outer garments?
questions.explanation: He took a towel and wrapped it around his waist, poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet.

answers.text: He broke bread and gave thanks
He began to wash the disciples' feet
He read aloud from the law
He washed his own hands

questions.text: What did Jesus answer when Peter said he would never let him wash his feet?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered that if he did not wash him, Peter would have no part with him.

answers.text: You are already completely clean
Then you are no longer my disciple
You need no washing at all
If I don't wash you, you have no part with me

questions.text: What did Jesus say they ought to do, since he, the Lord and Teacher, had washed their feet?
questions.explanation: He said that they also ought to wash one another's feet, for he had given them an example to follow.

answers.text: Wash one another's feet
Forgive one another's debts
Give their goods to the poor
Keep the Passover together

questions.text: What does Jesus say about a servant and his lord?
questions.explanation: He says that a servant is not greater than his lord, nor is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

answers.text: A servant is greater than the one who sent him
A servant remains in the house forever
A servant is not greater than his lord
A servant knows all that his lord does

questions.text: What did Jesus testify when he was troubled in spirit?
questions.explanation: He testified that one of those at the table with him would betray him.

answers.text: That they would all leave him alone
That one of them did not believe
That the world would hate them
That one of them would betray him

questions.text: Whom did Simon Peter beckon to, to ask who it was that Jesus meant?
questions.explanation: Peter beckoned to the disciple whom Jesus loved, who was at the table leaning against Jesus.

answers.text: Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot
The disciple whom Jesus loved
One of the chief priests
A servant at the supper

questions.text: How did Jesus show who would betray him?
questions.explanation: He said it is the one to whom he would give the piece of bread when he had dipped it, and he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

answers.text: He named him aloud to everyone
He washed his feet last of all
He gave him a piece of dipped bread
He laid his hand on his head

questions.text: What does the text say about the time when Judas went out?
questions.explanation: Having received that morsel, he went out immediately, and the text says it was night.

answers.text: It was night
It was early morning
It was the sixth hour
It was a Sabbath

questions.text: By what will everyone know that they are his disciples?
questions.explanation: He gives them a new commandment to love one another, and says that by this everyone will know they are his disciples.

answers.text: By the signs they will do
By washing feet in the temple
By keeping the Passover
By their love for one another

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Peter would happen before the rooster crowed?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that the rooster would not crow until Peter had denied him three times.

answers.text: Peter would lay down his life
Peter would deny him three times
Peter would betray him for money
Peter would follow him at once
